question: You made 4 Afterpay payments in October totalling $200.50. Were these planned purchases?
why_asking: Multiple buy-now-pay-later payments increase your credit commitments. Bureaus see BNPL as credit, and missed payments get reported.
impact: Reducing BNPL usage means fewer credit commitments reported to bureaus

question: Your Westpac Visa repayment on 12 Oct was 3 days late. Would a reminder or autopay help?
why_asking: Late repayments are the #1 factor in your credit score. Even a few days late can be recorded if it happens repeatedly.
impact: On-time repayments are the strongest positive signal for your credit score

question: You're paying for Netflix ($22.99), Stan ($12), Disney+ ($13.99) and Spotify ($12.99). Do you actively use all four?
why_asking: That's $61.97/month on streaming. Cutting unused ones frees cash for debt repayment — which directly helps your credit health.

answer_options.label: I could drop one or two

impact: Saving $25+/month that goes toward on-time repayments

question: Your Anytime Fitness direct debit ($65) bounced last month. Want to move the debit date to after payday?
why_asking: A dishonoured direct debit means insufficient funds. Too many of these signal financial stress to credit bureaus.

answer_options.label: I want to cancel the gym

impact: No more dishonoured payments = cleaner credit record

question: Your Vodafone plan is $65/month. There are similar plans from $35/month. Want to see options?
why_asking: Saving $30/month means $360/year that could go toward paying down your credit card faster.
impact: Lower bills = more cash to stay on top of repayments
